comments.author: @tnolan3176
comments.text: But the World Health organization wants the developed countries to go carbon net zero while these under developed countries create enough pollution to destroy the rest of the world !

replies.author: @TheGlobalTruth04
replies.text: I understand your concern. Pollution and emissions are global issues, but responsibility is complex because developed countries have historically produced a large share of cumulative emissions, while many developing countries are still trying to raise living standards. The real challenge is finding a fair way for every country to reduce pollution without holding back development.
